column1: # The FPGA-to-SDRAM bridge at the fabric: per port bit, the routing-graph node it meets. Its
# requests (AW, W, AR, the B and R readies) and its clock enter the SM_SOC_MPFE atom, not the
# HPS's: in = the fabric drives it (the RPII sink); out = it drives the fabric (the last
# SOC_MPFE_WRAPPER_RE node of its route). F2SDRAM_CLK is a global-clock sink. 32 of the 44
# address bits. From a Quartus 26.1.1 route dump (tools/hps_routes.tcl, HPS_ROUTES_ATOMS='SOC_HPS
# SM_SOC_MPFE', HPS_ROUTES_MATCH='F2SDRAM_* F2SOC_*') of designs/hpsf built with HPSF_BRIDGEMAP,
# tabled by tools/hps_table.py; the ports between the two atoms (flush, TBU interrupts, bridge
# reset, port size) are left out.
